messages:
Nina (CS Ops): Thinking out loud 1: can we automate a monthly SLO pack for ValoraHealth? PDF + dashboard link + precomputed credit exposure so CSM can send at renewal.
Maya (CSM): Yes please. Need p50/p95/p99 latency, uptime %, number of incidents, and a simple credit estimate per the SLA. Visuals should be one pager.
Ravi (SRE): We have the metrics in MetricsAPI. I can expose an endpoint that returns per-route histograms and error counts. Prefer 30-day rolling window for consistency.
Priya (Finance): Credit calc rules must match contract table. Typical formula we use: credit = min(monthly_fee, max(0, (SLO_target - observed)/SLO_target) * monthly_fee * multiplier). I'll put the multiplier and cap in a spreadsheet.
Ethan (Legal): Quick flag: any automated "credit estimate" sent to customers must say "estimate" and include contract link. No unilateral commitments. We'll need a standard disclaimer.
Sam (Product): Suggest adding a latency heatmap (hour of day vs p95) so CS can show when issues happened. Also mark deployment windows.
Nina (CS Ops): Good calls. For the pipeline, Ravi: can you return a JSON like {"route":"/v1/generate","p95":250,"uptime_pct":99.98,"errors":12}? we'll transform into PDF.
Ravi (SRE): I can do that. Sample PromQL for p95 we plan to use:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="inference"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Ravi (SRE): Also will include a per-route request count and error rate timeseries. Endpoint will be auth'd.
Maya (CSM): How will we present the credit calc? Need the math in plain english and a sample row.
Priya (Finance): I'll draft a table: period, observed uptime, SLO target, delta, raw_credit_pct, applied_cap_pct, estimated_credit($). Example row: 30d, 99.6%, 99.9%, 0.3%, 0.3%*monthly_fee*1.5 = $X (cap 100% monthly_fee).
Ethan (Legal): Add the disclaimer line and link to SLA PDF. Wording: "This estimate is non-binding; final credit determined per contract and validated by Redwood finance."
Sam (Product): For visuals we can reuse the CS dashboard widget library. I'll add a small script to export PNGs for the PDF.
ReportBot: Automated report template created: /reports/valora/slo_monthly_template v1.0. Scheduled monthly on the 1st at 08:00 UTC.
Nina (CS Ops): Action list: Ravi - metrics endpoint + sample JSON (ETA 48h); Priya - credit calc spreadsheet and sample row (ETA 24h); Ethan - disclaimer copy (ETA 24h); Sam - export script and widget list (ETA 48h); Maya - review customer language and approve visuals (ETA 72h). I'll assemble PDF template after pieces land.
Maya (CSM): One more ask: include a small FAQ section that explains why short transient drops may not trigger credits (burstable auto-healing, cache warmups). I'll send a draft.
Nina (CS Ops): Perfect. I'll post the template link and mark threads as blocked/unblocked. Thanks all :rocket:
ReportBot: Next run will produce a draft report in the staging bucket for review at 1769690400.
